quantities.readouts: first-order diagonal error of each seed's correction, averaged over the seeds
quantities.product: error of the corrected band positions of the seed-mean correction

accuracy.target_source: 3 cm⁻¹ per family — decision 53's line for ring-ip, CH-oop and 'other', every family's under decision 65 (the licence) — and the coupling ratio ≤ 0.25 of chain 35's T1 line (probes/chain35_read.py)

definitions.family: rms over the family's B3LYP modes of the first-order diagonal error of a seed's ΔH against the higher level, per seed, and the seeds' mean (cm⁻¹); families by module 05's rule (m05/learning_curve_layerA.molecule_features)
definitions.product: rms over the family's bands of the corrected band position's error against the higher level (cm⁻¹): the seeds' mean ΔH added to the B3LYP Hessian and diagonalised, each corrected band paired to its higher-level band by mode overlap and counted in the family of its B3LYP partner — what the pipeline prints; with the 95 % interval of a bootstrap over whole molecules
definitions.coupling_ratio: rms of the predicted mode couplings' error over the rms of the couplings themselves; 0 = exact, 1 = no better than none
definitions.spectrum_overlap: cosine similarity of the two Lorentzian-broadened spectra (FWHM 10 cm⁻¹, 500–3500 cm⁻¹); 1 = identical shape
definitions.intensity_error: intensity-weighted rms of the relative height error per band, bands paired by the shape of the motion (eigenvector overlap); 0 = identical heights

accuracy.coupled_cluster: not measured for this network version: the coupled-cluster reads (T3) were made on an earlier network (chain 34)

own_spread.text: Each band's own spread was measured for this molecule: the networks corrected it again in 11 other presentations (8 rotations, 2 mirror images, 1 swap of equivalent atoms), and a band's spread is the furthest its position lay from the printed one in any of them: its distance from the printed presentation, not the range between presentations. The largest is 0.11 cm⁻¹, under the mirror image, and no band moved by more than the licence line.

statement: furan: the infrared spectrum of ΔH-network v1.4 (3 seeds) — B3LYP/6-31G* corrected toward ωB97X/6-31G*. The spectrum is made by the release networks of version 1.4, trained on the 1132 labelled entries of their training pool, hold-outs (a) and (b) included: each of the 3 networks is fitted on a random 85 % of the molecules and stopped on the other 15 %, a different 15 % per seed, so not every molecule is fitted by every network (with 3 networks about 0.15³ ≈ 0.3 % by none). Its error bars were measured on the measurement networks of the same version — the same recipe trained without the hold-out molecules — on molecules those networks never saw; the release networks themselves have seen the molecules of hold-outs (a) and (b), so they have no held-out error of their own. The error stated is the measurement networks' error of the corrected band positions of the seed-mean correction; the harmonic positions ω are licensed for ring-ip, CH-stretch, CH-oop, other (decision 65) where a band's own position moved by no more than the licence line in the 11 presentations tried (this molecule turned, mirrored or listed in another atom order), each band marked; at the coupled-cluster level not measured for this network version: the coupled-cluster reads (T3) were made on an earlier network (chain 34). Each band's own spread was measured for this molecule: the networks corrected it again in 11 other presentations (8 rotations, 2 mirror images, 1 swap of equivalent atoms), and a band's spread is the furthest its position lay from the printed one in any of them: its distance from the printed presentation, not the range between presentations. The largest is 0.11 cm⁻¹, under the mirror image, and no band moved by more than the licence line. The scaled B3LYP spectrum is shown as the baseline only. This molecule and the ΔH network: not in the catalogue: the network has not seen it.
